newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo to give away malaria drug - paper.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo to give away malaria drug - paper.

text.p: Pharmaceutical giant Glaxo Wellcome Plc is set to give away supplies of its new malaria drug to sufferers from the disease in developing countries, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.
The drug, called Malarone, is about to be approved for marketing in Britain, and developing countries usually give the green light once British approval has been granted, the paper said.
Between two to three million people die each year of malaria, acocording to the World Health Organisation.
Trials of Malarone showed that the malaria parasite was eliminated from the blood in 98.5 percent of the 400 people taking the drug, the Financial Times said.
